title: Concept: Script executed in the host context (javascript)
description: In javascript, vm.runInThisContext evaluates code with the process's own globals in reach. Any interpolation into that string becomes arbitrary code in the service account's context.
applicability: Plugin hosts, rule engines, templating helpers and 'evaluate this expression' features; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Arbitrary code execution in the service account, with access to its secrets and network position; MEDIUM severity.
